description: Every dependency PR touches the root pnpm-lock.yaml, so release-please attributes it to the core sfn-diagram package. The shared preset types bot commits chore/ci (never fix/feat) so they can't cut a release; retitle a PR to fix(deps) by hand when a shipped dependency should trigger a patch release

packageRules.description: typedoc (0.28.20, the latest) needs minimatch ^10 and throws in expandGlobs on 11 (#644), while GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 has no patched 10.x. The site's typedoc step reads only repo-controlled globs, so the advisory is accepted in pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreGhsas. A packageRule with enabled=false also stops vulnerability-fix PRs. Drop this and the ignore entry once typedoc accepts minimatch 11
TypeScript 7's npm package has no classic compiler API (it exports only ./unstable/*), and typescript-eslint and @astrojs/check don't accept it. Drop this once those tools support 7
@types/vscode must not exceed the extension's engines.vscode floor: vsce refuses to package when it does. Bump both by hand, in one commit
Which Node line the image tracks is an LTS decision, not a version bump: odd majors are never LTS and Node 25+ dropped corepack from the image
Container image bumps are typed build and labeled docker, as they were under Dependabot
react-dom reads React internals, so a React major moves the whole family, types included, in one PR
